phase-436 W7. Whether a platform park primitive is installed. Load-bearing rather than informational: a park that waits on its own fresh object is NOT breakable by the backend's listener, and installing one makes latency WORSE — once a port has parked, the transport drain drops to non-blocking, so an unbreakable park sleeps out its full deadline with data already waiting.
